def parse_prefix(text, label):
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        raise Fatal('%s must be a string' % label)
    parts = text.split('/')
    if len(parts) != 2:
        raise Fatal('%s must be an explicit CIDR' % label)
    addr_text, len_text = parts
    if len_text != '56' and len_text != '64':
        raise Fatal('%s prefix length must be /56 or /64' % label)
    plen = 56 if len_text == '56' else 64
    value = ipv6_value(addr_text)
    if value is None:
        raise Fatal('%s is not a valid documentation IPv6 prefix' % label)
    mask = ((1 << plen) - 1) << (128 - plen)
    if value & ~mask:
        raise Fatal('%s has host bits set' % label)
    return value, plen
```

def read_bytes(path, max_bytes, label):
    if path == '-':
        raise Fatal('%s: stdin input is not supported' % label)
    try:
        handle = open(path, 'rb')
    except OSError as exc:
        raise Fatal('cannot open %s: %s' % (label, exc))
    with handle:
        try:
            st = os.fstat(handle.fileno())
        except OSError as exc:
            raise Fatal(...)
        if not stat_module.S_ISREG(st.st_mode):
            raise Fatal('%s is not a regular file' % label)
        data = handle.read(max_bytes + 1)
        if len(data) > max_bytes:
            raise Fatal('%s exceeds the %d byte limit' % (label, max_bytes))
    return data
```
